title: Features
summary: The major ways Nightcap changes standard EverQuest.
body:
The changes that reshape how you build, explore and progress in EverQuest. Classic is the current chapter; the level cap is 50.

Three classes. One character.

Keep your starting class and choose two more from level 1. Combine their spells, skills, equipment access and strongest base HP/mana calculations.

Build your character →

AA progression from the beginning

Earn two AA per level-equivalent while leveling, or allocate up to 100% of eligible XP to AA. The allowed pool opens at level 1, with earned points and prerequisites.

Plan your AA progression →

Classic dungeons, your way

Choose respawning Grind runs or harder Raid runs with permanent enemy deaths. Personal boss checklists and exclusive rewards give all 21 Classic dungeons a new purpose.

Choose a dungeon mode →

Loot that grows with you

Find Polished, Exalted and Ascended ordinary gear, hunt custom rewards in 48 zones, and turn matching duplicates into upgrades. Trade gear freely and equip across your held classes.

Understand gear progression →

Build a roster of companions

Summon multiple pets, command one or all, manage their equipment and develop pet builds through earned gear and abilities.

Manage your pets →

Combat built around your whole build

Instant DoT casts, melee while casting, lasting ordinary blessings and earned class synergies support new combinations. Normal death preserves EXP and belongings.

Read the combat rules →

A home base and a world to discover

Prepare in the Commonlands tunnel, use its travel network and unlock waypoint return destinations through exploration.

Find your way around →

Original endgame stories

The Vigil of the Dawn is a demanding level-50 Paladin capstone with personal chapters, custom Chapterhouse encounters and an earned helmet.

Explore the Vigil →

Practical guides: Item upgrades · Crafting · Loot controls · Launcher. Fixes and smaller updates: Change Log.
